title.name: BEYOND SAGITTARIUS
title.subtitle: A Survival Story Beyond the Known Universe
title.tagline: Humanity conquered the stars. Now you must learn how to survive without civilisation.
title.slice: Vertical slice · Prologue + The First 24 Hours
menu.newGameConfirm: Starting a new game will erase your saved progress.
settings.title: Settings
settings.qualityNote: Changing quality reloads the game. Your progress is saved first.
controls.title: Controls
controls.look: Mouse — look around (click the world to lock the cursor)
controls.touch: Touch: left side moves, right side looks, tap the prompt to interact
cine.caption1: Humanity now lives across the Solar System — the cities of Mars, the laboratories of Europa, the stations of Titan, the foundries of the Moon.
cine.caption2: Six friends booked the trip of a lifetime: a tourist voyage to the heart of the galaxy.
cine.mission2: DESTINATION: MILKY WAY GALACTIC CENTRE OBSERVATION CORRIDOR
cine.line1: Imagine if we actually find aliens.
cine.line2: Bro, I just want to come back with good photographs.
cine.line3: Six friends, one ship, the centre of the galaxy. Best holiday ever.
cine.montage: Day 41 — beyond the edge of charted space
cine.line5: That reading is impossible. Gravity doesn't do that.
cine.ai1: WARNING. UNIDENTIFIED GRAVITATIONAL DISTURBANCE DETECTED. NAVIGATION SYSTEMS EXPERIENCING ANOMALOUS DEVIATION.
cine.ai2: CRITICAL FAILURE. STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY: 41%. PROPULSION: OFFLINE. EMERGENCY PROTOCOL INITIATED.
cine.line7: EVERYONE GET TO THE ESCAPE PODS!
wake.line2: Two worlds in the sky. That is not our Moon.
wake.line4: Something is moving between the trees. Something huge.
wake.line5: Stay calm. Think like a scientist. Water first.
hud.helpHint: J objectives · C crew · Esc pause
level.1.title: Find Water
level.1.desc: Your suit's water reserve is empty. Find a source of water and drink.
level.1.hint: Your suit sensor detects moisture. Follow the marker on the compass.
level.2.title: Find Food
level.2.desc: Your strength is fading. Find something you can safely eat.
level.2.hint: Strange fruit grows near the water. Examine before you eat.
level.3.title: Collect Stones and Branches
level.3.desc: Gather 5 stones and 5 branches. You will need them to make tools.
level.4.title: Make Primitive Tools
level.5.title: Find Shelter Before Nightfall
level.6.title: Build a Fire
level.7.title: Survive the First Night
level.8.title: Investigate an Unfamiliar Plant
level.9.title: Find Evidence That Something Else Lives Here
level.10.title: Find a Perfectly Undamaged Ship Fragment
level.sliceEnd: You have reached the end of this build. Levels 4–10 are coming soon — explore freely until night falls.
medic.hint: You remember Leila, the Medic: “Never eat what you can't identify. Thorns and oily skins mean poison. Test a small piece first — rub it on your skin and wait.”
fruit.examineBlue: Smooth skin, a soft blue glow, a faint sweet smell. No reaction on your skin. Probably safe.
fruit.examineRed: Hard thorns and an oily red skin. Your fingers tingle where you touched it. Bad idea.
fruit.ateBlue: Sweet and strange — like pear and pepper. Your body accepts it.
fruit.ateRed: Your stomach cramps violently. That was a mistake.
msg.drink: Cold, metallic, clean enough. The suit filter agrees.
msg.drinkFull: You are not thirsty right now.
msg.deep: Too deep. You can't swim in this suit.
msg.thirsty: Your throat is burning. You need water.
msg.night: Night is falling. Bioluminescence wakes up across the forest.
death.title: YOU DID NOT SURVIVE
death.text: This world does not forgive mistakes. But you remember what went wrong.
objectives.title: Objectives — The First 24 Hours
crew.title: The Crew
crew.note: Names and genders can be customised in a future build. Find your friends to unlock their skills.
crew.scientist.name: Ayaan Qureshi
crew.scientist.line: A genius in physics, engineering, AI and the theory of medicine. Can explain a black hole, cannot open a jar.
crew.strong.name: Viktor Kade
crew.strong.line: Carries twice his share, cuts trees, builds walls, and is the first to step between the group and danger.
crew.medic.name: Leila Haddad
crew.medic.line: Calm under pressure. Treats injuries, identifies plants and turns roots into medicine.
crew.explorer.name: Mira Santos
crew.explorer.line: Reads tracks like text. Finds water, food and the way home when everyone else is lost.
crew.builder.name: Kenji Arai
crew.builder.line: Thinks with his hands. Tools, shelters, machines, vehicles — give him scrap and time.
crew.social.name: Priya Nair
crew.social.line: The glue of the group. Leads, negotiates, keeps morale alive and gets six stubborn people organised.
